Completes portable document export on macOS, Linux amd64, and Raspberry Pi. The Export menu creates editable Word documents, fixed-layout Letter PDFs, or reflowable EPUB 3 ebooks from the current sheet, a selected folder, or the complete active project without changing the source Markdown.

Multi-sheet exports can be ordered alphabetically or by creation date, include a title page and author byline, and begin each sheet on a new page or EPUB chapter. Title, author, language, scope, ordering, and layout choices can be saved as reusable presets.

All three formats use one shared CommonMark structure for titles, headings, paragraphs, emphasis, quotations, lists, code, and scene breaks. YAML front matter is omitted, matching opening titles are not duplicated, and destinations are written atomically. PDF embeds open Source Serif 4 fonts for portable Unicode text; EPUB includes metadata, navigation, XHTML, and local CSS. Markdown tables and image embedding remain planned follow-up work. Editing, autosave, History, universal sync, Inbox, and Trash behavior are unchanged.

Signed desktop release for macOS Apple Silicon, Linux amd64, and Raspberry Pi ARM64.

This is a personal project under active development. Back up important writing and review the release notes before updating.
